sources.snippet: Israeli/global manufacturer. 93% quartz, 7% resin. Breton technology. Multiple plant locations (Israel, Georgia USA, India, China) — quality consistency across plants is the concern. GREENGUARD Gold. Strong brand but multi-source manufacturing introduces variance risk that Cambria avoids.
